english: I'm an AI assistant for {org} — but I can help with most things right away, and I'll bring in a human colleague the moment you'd prefer one. What can I do for you?
current_ha: Ni mataimaki ne na AI na {org} — amma zan iya taimaka maka nan take a abubuwa da yawa, kuma duk lokacin da kake son mutum, zan kawo abokin aiki. Me zan yi maka?

english: Connecting you to a live human agent right away. Please hold on a moment...
current_ha: Ina hada ka da mutum yanzu. Don Allah ka dan jira...

english: Payment goes to {account}, {bank}, account number {number}.
current_ha: Za a biya zuwa {account}, {bank}, lambar asusu {number}.

english: You can also dial {ussd}.
current_ha: Kuma za ka iya buga {ussd}.

english: I don't have our payment details on hand to share with you, and I don't want to give you the wrong account. Let me pass you to a colleague at {org} who can help.
current_ha: Ba ni da cikakken bayanin biyan kudi a yanzu, kuma ba na son ba ka asusun da ba daidai ba. Bari in hada ka da ma’aikacin {org} da zai taimaka.

english: I can't find an upcoming appointment under this number.
current_ha: Ban sami wani alkawari mai zuwa a wannan lambar ba.

english: I ran into a technical problem completing that automatically. Let me connect you with a team member who can help right away.
current_ha: An sami matsala yayin da nake yin haka kai tsaye. Bari in hada ka da ma’aikaci da zai taimaka nan take.

english:
Here's what I can do for you at {org}:

• Book, check, move or cancel an appointment
• Share our payment details when you want to pay
• File a complaint or report a problem
• Raise a refund request
• Answer questions about our services

And any time you'd rather talk to a person, just say *"speak to an agent"*.
current_ha:
Ga abin da zan iya yi maka a {org}:

• Yin alkawari, duba shi, canza shi ko soke shi
• Ba ka bayanin yadda za ka biya
• Daukar korafi ko rahoton matsala
• Neman mayar da kudi
• Amsa tambayoyi game da ayyukanmu

Duk lokacin da kake son mutum, ka ce *"speak to an agent"*.

english:
Which language would you like me to use? Reply with a number:

1 — English
2 — Nigerian Pidgin
3 — Hausa
4 — Igbo
5 — Yorùbá
current_ha:
Wane harshe kake so in yi amfani da shi? Ka amsa da lamba:

1 — English
2 — Nigerian Pidgin
3 — Hausa
4 — Igbo
5 — Yorùbá

english: Done — I'll reply in English from now on. Say *"change language"* any time you want to switch.
current_ha: An gama — zan yi maka magana da Hausa daga yanzu. Ka ce *"change language"* duk lokacin da kake son canzawa.

english: I understand you, but I cannot speak {language} on a call — only English. I can bring in a colleague who speaks {language}, or we can continue on WhatsApp where I can write to you in it. Which would you prefer?
current_ha: I understand you, but I cannot speak {language} on a call — only English. I can bring in a colleague who speaks {language}, or we can continue on WhatsApp where I can write to you in it. Which would you prefer?

english: No problem — I've stopped that. Tell me any time you'd like to start again.
current_ha: Babu matsala — na daina. Ka gaya mini duk lokacin da kake son sake farawa.

english: No problem. Which part should I change?
current_ha: Babu matsala. Wanne bangare zan canza?

english: Let's get you registered. What is your full name, as it should appear on your health card?
current_ha: Mu yi maka rijista. Menene cikakken sunanka, kamar yadda zai bayyana a katin lafiyarka?

english: Could you give me your full name — first name and surname?
current_ha: Ka ba ni cikakken sunanka — sunan farko da sunan mahaifi.

english: That looks like it has numbers in it. What is your full name?
current_ha: Wannan yana da lambobi a ciki. Menene cikakken sunanka?

english: Thank you, {name}. How old are you, or what is your date of birth?
current_ha: Na gode, {name}. Shekarunka nawa ne, ko kuma ranar haihuwarka?

english: That age does not look right. How old are you, in years?
current_ha: Wannan shekarun ba su yi daidai ba. Shekarunka nawa ne?

english: Could you tell me your age in years, or your date of birth?
current_ha: Ka gaya mini shekarunka, ko ranar haihuwarka.

english: What is your street address, or the area where you live?
current_ha: Menene adireshinka, ko yankin da kake zama?

english: Could you give me a bit more — the street or the area you live in?
current_ha: Ka kara bayani kadan — titi ko yankin da kake zama.

english: Which Local Government Area do you live in? For example: Jos North, Jos South, Barkin Ladi, Mangu, Shendam.
current_ha: A wace Karamar Hukuma kake zama? Misali: Jos North, Jos South, Barkin Ladi, Mangu, Shendam.

english: I could not match that to a Plateau State LGA. Could you tell me which one you live in? The full list is: {list}.
current_ha: Ban gane wannan a matsayin Karamar Hukuma ta Jihar Filato ba.\nKa zabi daga cikin: {list}.

english:
Which describes you best?

1 — Formal Sector (you work for a company or government)
2 — Informal Sector (self-employed, trader, farmer, artisan)
3 — Equity Programme (free: pregnant, child under 5, over 65, living with a disability)
4 — BHCPF (free, for the most vulnerable)

Reply with the number or the name.
current_ha:
Wanne ya fi dacewa da kai?

1 — Formal Sector (kana aiki da kamfani ko gwamnati)
2 — Informal Sector (kai da kanka, dan kasuwa, manomi, masani)
3 — Equity Programme (kyauta: mai ciki, yaro kasa da shekara 5, sama da 65, mai nakasa)
4 — BHCPF (kyauta, ga wadanda suka fi bukata)

Ka amsa da lamba ko suna.

english: I did not catch which plan that is. Reply 1 for Formal Sector, 2 for Informal Sector, 3 for the free Equity Programme, or 4 for BHCPF.
current_ha: Ban gane wanne shiri ba ne. Ka amsa 1 don Formal Sector, 2 don Informal Sector, 3 don Equity Programme na kyauta, ko 4 don BHCPF.

english: Which hospital or health centre in {lga} would you like as your primary facility?\n\nAccredited options: {options}.
current_ha: Wanne asibiti ko cibiyar lafiya a {lga} kake son ya zama babbar cibiyarka?\n\nWadanda aka amince da su: {options}.

english: That one is not on the accredited list for {lga}, and a card issued against it would be refused at the desk. Please choose one of: {options}.
current_ha: Wannan ba ya cikin jerin da aka amince da su a {lga}, kuma za a ki karbar katin a teburin. Ka zabi daya daga cikin: {options}.

english: Last one, and it is optional: do you have your National Identification Number (NIN)? It speeds things up, but we can register you without it — just say "no".
current_ha: Na karshe, kuma ba dole ba ne: kana da lambar NIN? Tana saurin aiki, amma za mu iya yi maka rijista ba tare da ita ba — ka ce "a'a".

english: A NIN is 11 digits. Could you check and send it again, or say "no" to continue without it?
current_ha: NIN lambobi 11 ne. Ka duba ka sake aikawa, ko ka ce "a'a" mu ci gaba ba tare da ita ba.

current_ha: ba a bayar ba
